name: Nutella
description: Hazelnut and cocoa spread made by Ferrero. Popular as a breakfast topping on toast, pancakes, and crepes. Sweet, smooth, and calorie dense, with most of its energy coming from sugar and palm oil.

faqs.a: Yes. A 100 gram serving contains 56.3 grams of sugar, which is more than the full daily recommended limit for an adult. A typical serving of two tablespoons (about 37 grams) still contains around 21 grams of sugar.

faqs.q: Is Nutella a healthy breakfast choice?
faqs.a: Nutella is best treated as a dessert topping rather than a daily breakfast staple. While it does contain some hazelnuts and skim milk powder, the primary ingredients by weight are sugar and palm oil.
